text:
sam (support): Escalating PioneerHealth onboarding - customer says their semantic search is returning unrelated results and the Dedicated workspace provisioning is stuck (403). Renewal/contract review in ~26 days. Marking P1 -> escalate to CS.
aya (cs): Copy. Any error text / request ids? Do we have a customer screenshot of the search mismatch?
sam (support): UI shows `No relevant results` then returns generic docs. Customer pasted request id `req-9b3f` and a screenshot of the search hit list that is clearly off. Provision API returned 403 with request `prov-47a`. Logs attached. They started the embed ingestion job and then hit the provisioning step.
mike (cs): Assigning @todd to triage provisioning 403, I'll own customer comms and coordinate enablement. Looping @neha if renewal risk rises.
todd (eng): Quick initial: provisioner returned 403 because tenant `pioneerhealth` was in a quarantine state after an automated KMS rotation check failed. Separately, embedding service shows an older model vector schema being used for recent ingests -> mismatch causing poor search relevance. Two separate issues. I'm running an unblock for provisioning: `servicectl tenant-unquarantine pioneerhealth --reason=kms-check-fix`
ops-bot: tenant-unquarantine job started (job=tu-2209) for pioneerhealth
sam (support): After unblock call, follow-up provision attempts succeeded for a short window but then a rate-limit kicked in and another 403 appeared for ~30s.
todd (eng): Noted. There is a transient throttle on provisioner due to concurrent onboarding jobs in region eu-west1. I'll raise provisioner concurrency and reindex vectors to the current schema. Commands: `servicectl scale provisioner=+1 --region=eu-west1` and `python -m vectool reindex --tenant pioneerhealth --schema v2`
mike (cs): For comms: I'll send a brief customer note: "Hi Jamie - thanks, we found two causes: 1) an automated KMS rotation check put your tenant in a temporary quarantine which blocked provisioning (we unquarantined it), and 2) your early ingestion used a legacy embedding schema which reduced search relevance. We reindexed your vectors to the current schema and increased provisioning throughput. Please re-run a sample search and let us know the top 3 results. We'll monitor for 24 hours and can schedule a 1-hour enablement session to walk through search tuning." Sending now.
neha (sales): FYI PioneerHealth is in a mid-renewal upsell track. If this looks like it will affect go-live we should offer a small concession (3 hours free enablement + priority onboarding slot) to keep momentum.
todd (eng): Reindex kicked off; plan to watch for errors and finish in ~12 minutes. Also added a guard to reject legacy-schema ingests with clearer errors.
ops-bot: reindex job started (job=rx-3344) for pioneerhealth; estimated time 12m
sam (support): Customer replied: "Search is much better now, provisioning completed and we see the new workspace. Thanks for fast help." (received ~14m after reindex start)
mike (cs): Updating CRM: onboarding -> "Completed (search tuned)", renewal_risk -> "Low (monitor)". Recording feedback: customer asked for clearer error when schema mismatch occurs; will capture as product request. Offered 1-hour enablement session; customer accepted a scheduled slot next week.
todd (eng): Leaving monitoring for 3 hours on provisioner and embedding pipeline: `tail -n 200 /var/log/provisioner/pioneerhealth.log | grep ERROR` and `kubectl logs -l app=embedder -n prod | grep pioneerhealth`. Alert if 403 or reindex failures.
mike (cs): Closing escalation. Actions: Mike finalize CRM notes + schedule enablement, Todd monitor 3h and coordinate with infra if throttles recur, Sam keep an eye on support alerts, Neha to stay in loop for renewal cadence. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
